title: Some undefined sorrow was hidden in the hearts of the protagonists as they stood in silence beneath the leafless trees and when the moment of farewell had come the kiss, which had been withheld by one, was given by both.
html_source: This excerpt comes from Stephen’s attempt to relive the time he spent with E.C. –a woman who he met at the children’s party at Harold’s Cross, with whom he shares his first crush– through a poem. The initial finishing of the poem shows the development of Stephen as a writer, because before when he tried to write a poem about Parnell, he failed. However, through the process of writing and the success of finishing it gave Stephen a boost of self-confidence. Thus developing his character as a teenager who’s slowly but surely finding himself in his own messed up world.
